component.name: Tofromm
component.summary: Sync ROMs and saves between your Linux machine and a ROMM server

description.p: Tofromm syncs your ROMs and save files between a self-hosted ROMM server and local emulators such as RetroArch, Duckstation, PCSX2, and more. Pick games from your library, download them with their saves, and upload saves back when you're done.
